title: Norwegian Sushi Rolls
description: A unique fusion of traditional Norwegian ingredients with sushi. Perfect for adventurous foodies!

ingredients.name: Cured Salmon
ingredients.notes: Norwegian salmon, cured in salt and sugar

instructions: Prepare the sushi rice according to the package instructions.
Cut the cured salmon into thin slices.
Mix the dill, lemon juice, and sesame oil in a small bowl.
Spread a thin layer of wasabi onto the nori sheet.
Place a sheet of nori on a sushi mat, and spread a thin layer of sushi rice onto the nori.
Arrange the salmon slices on the rice, leaving a small border at the top.
Drizzle the dill mixture over the salmon, and top with pickled ginger.
Roll the sushi using the mat, applying gentle pressure.
Slice the roll into 8 equal pieces using a sharp knife.
Serve with soy sauce and wasabi, if desired.
